title: Capability RPC message (capability-rpc/1) — one JSON object per line

id.$comment: Correlation id, host-assigned for host->ext calls, extension-assigned for ext->host capability calls; echoed by result/error. 'ok' for events is not permitted — events carry ids only for audit correlation.

method.$comment: Closed method vocabulary (extension-charter.json rpc) — an unknown method is a protocol error and the call is refused (never dispatched).

additionalProperties.$comment: Params are method-specific (typed shapes in capability-rpc.md §4/§5); the schema bounds the envelope — hosts validate params per method at the seam. String values are capped at 8192 chars host-side (framing cap: one line <= limits.rpcLineMaxBytes).

result.$comment: Method-specific result payload (typed shapes in the spec); bounded by the framing cap.

allOf.$comment: Events are never calls (and vice versa) — the type discriminates.

code.$comment: The charter error enum, verbatim (extension-charter.json errors) — one typed vocabulary across manifests, envelopes and the seam.

detail.$comment: A bounded object, never a string (7E wire truth): JSON-encoded-string details are deleted. Declared keys only; `message` is the capped host diagnostic for logs/typed machine surfaces — product UI copy is keyed by `code` and may interpolate the data keys, never `message` raw.

errorDetail.$comment: The closed detail vocabulary (plan 37 7E / D3, bounded object): paths, field names, ids, engine kind, hop/host, caps — data, never prose. `message` is the one capped diagnostic slot (logs/typed machine surfaces); product copy is keyed by `code`. Construction rules (validator-owned, mirrored at both seams): only declared keys survive; `message` truncates at 400 chars; the SERIALIZED object is capped at limits.errorDetailMaxChars (truncate `message` first, then drop non-message keys).

$comment: STRUCTURAL GATE for one framed line. The protocol's behavioral law lives in contracts/capability-rpc.md: one process per extension, frozen module surface, wall-clock + memory watchdogs per call, per-extension quotas, one audit row per capability call, secrets never crossing the seam, net only via the host-side polite runtime scoped to declared domains (all hops).
